children: South Korea's exports soared 93.7% year-on-year to a fresh record high of USD 115.3 billion in October 2026, surpassing estimates of 93.2% and accelerating from a marginally revised 83.7% jump in September.
It was the fastest increase since January 1974, driven by strong demand for memory chips, preliminary data showed.

title: South Korea Exports Exports Hit New High in October
